body.name: rational interval representation of design inputs
body.construction: At request \(m\in\mathbb N\), return the nested rational box \(\mathfrak r(m)=\prod_j[r^-_j(m),r^+_j(m)]\) containing \((p,c_M,c_I,\alpha,G)\), with maximum coordinate width at most \(2^{-m}\), preserving positive lower bounds for the rate and cost coordinates, \(0<\alpha<1\), and \(G\ge0\).
